messages:
Raj (Sales): Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth wants a perf POC next Tue. Goal: 99th pct latency < 250ms for text-generation (avg prompt 120 tokens). Need load plan, cost ballpark, and security checklist. Who can lead? 
Maya (Solutions Eng): I can own the load plan. Proposed: 3 phases — smoke, soak, stress. Smoke: 10 clients -> 50 qps. Soak: 100 clients -> 400 qps for 2h. Stress: ramp to 1k qps (short bursts) to exercise tail. Warmup 20m with prefix caching. 
Liz (AE): FYI AcmeHealth requires HIPAA-compliant hosting + VPC. They asked about private deployment options and KMS. 
Chen (Security): Re: HIPAA/VPC: we'll need A) VPC peering or PrivateLink, B) customer KMS integration (bring-your-own ok), C) audits: SOC2 + runbook. Also need egress policy and encryption-in-transit TLS mutual auth for data plane. 
Omar (SRE): For latency target, recommend model variant with quantized weights and 8k context. Use per-request KV cache for repeated prefixes. Also set batch_timeout=10ms and max_batch_tokens=2048. Run tests from us-east-1 and eu-west-1 to validate region routing. 
Maya (Solutions Eng): Sample load command for our runner: 
```
runner --model redwood-alpha-3b-q4 --concurrency 400 --rate 400 --prompt-file acme_prompts.json --warmup 1200
```
Collect p50/p90/p99, token/sec, and GPU utl. 
Raj (Sales): Cost question from Acme: ~400 qps steady for 2h, what's rough cost delta between hosted vs dedicated? 
Maya (Solutions Eng): Quick ballpark: hosted ~ $0.08/token for heavy variants (very rough) — for 400 qps @ avg 100 tokens/resp => 40k tokens/sec => 144M tokens/hour. That's expensive; recommend Dedicated commit or quantized 3b to drop 3-4x. I'll run model choice costing and send numbers. 
Chen (Security): Also flag: they want answers to a vendor security questionnaire by EoD Friday. If we can't provide Private deployment sample, that's an enterprise blocker. 
Omar (SRE): Test plan checklist: 1) infra prep — VPC endpoints & peering test, 2) preload model cache, 3) schedule soak 02:00-04:00 UTC to avoid other tenants, 4) enable tracing via x-request-id, 5) capture perf traces and GPU metrics. 
deploy-bot: Scheduled load-test job 2061234705 for acme-poc-run — status: queued :rocket: 
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll patch the runbook with concrete numbers and upload results to the shared drive after the soak. Raj, can you confirm stakeholder availability for Tue? 
Raj (Sales): Confirmed — CTO + infra lead on call. Thanks team.
